title: Cloudflare postpones AI Search billing and lengthens its default sync interval
summary: Cloudflare moves AI Search billing to December 1 and its default sync to 24 hours, retaining a configurable 15-minute minimum.

# Cloudflare postpones AI Search billing and lengthens its default sync interval


By OpenTools Team


The billing date changes without new rates; synchronization remains configurable.


##


A later billing start


[Cloudflare’s November 2 changelog](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-11-02-billing-postponed-default-sync-interval/) moves AI Search billing from November 1 to December 1, 2026. It says usage before December 1 will not be charged; pricing and included usage are unchanged.


The deferral changes when billing begins, rather than announcing a different rate card. The linked pricing page was not reviewed for this report.


##


A separate freshness decision


[The default sync interval changes from six to 24 hours](https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-11-02-billing-postponed-default-sync-interval/) , while supported choices still run from 15 minutes to 24 hours.


That default does not identify a particular instance’s current setting or promise immediate updates. The billing postponement and the retrieval‑content refresh cadence are separate changes.
